text:
Alex (AE): Heads-up: Lifecare (large payer) wants a 5-day POC next Tue. Requirements: on-prem/VPC Private deploy, live streaming redaction (<200ms), SSO (SAML), customer KMS/HSM, no PHI persisted, SIEM-forwarded audit logs. Need quick pricing for reserved capacity. What do we need to start?

Rina - Solutions Eng: We can run Private in their VPC. Two clarifying Qs: 1) streaming protocol they prefer (websocket vs. SSE)? 2) do they want model-driven entity extraction + tool-call for deterministic redact, or purely regex + model? I can prepare an SDK streaming example and a tiny flow diagram.

Alex (AE): They asked for websocket streaming with immediate redaction before downstream ingestion. They want sub-200ms per message end-to-end.

Jorge (Security): Please obtain their IdP metadata and KMS key policy. Confirm if keys are customer-managed (we support AWS KMS/HSM integrations). Also need admin IP allowlist and retention SLA (they said 7 days). We'll need to complete their security questionnaire when they send it.

Rina - Solutions Eng: Suggested architecture: edge deterministic filter (regex) -> LLM entity confirmer -> local tool that applies redaction rules. Configure Private with persistence disabled for user content and forward logs to their SIEM (syslog/HTTPS). Small streaming SDK snippet below: 

```python
# minimal websocket streaming example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(private_endpoint="https://private.redwood.lifecare", token="<short-lived>")
with client.stream_chat(model="redwood-small-v2", protocol="websocket") as s:
    s.send({"role":"user","content":"Patient: Jane Doe, DOB 01/02/1970, MRN 55566"})
    for chunk in s:
        # chunk arrives incrementally
        handle(chunk)
```

Rina - Solutions Eng: For tool-calls we return structured JSON like {"entities": [{"type":"ssn","start":27,"end":38,"conf":0.98}],"sanitized":"Patient: [REDACTED]..."} and the local tool enforces redact rules before any further routing. We can mark model cache/persistence as ephemeral so nothing persists on Redwood-managed storage.

infra-bot: ticket POC-2217 created and assigned to Rina - Solutions Eng :white_check_mark:

Taylor (AM): For pricing, they expect baseline 800 reqs/min with 2x burst. Aim for reserved pool that covers baseline and allow burst via autoscale. I'll draft a ballpark: monthly reserved + overage. Rina, can you estimate GPU count for baseline and peak by Thu?

Rina - Solutions Eng: Rough estimate: for redwood-small-v2 at target latency we recommend 4 GPUs for baseline, 8 for peak (short burst). Will produce a more precise perf/cost table.

Jorge (Security): Notes for questionnaire: collection of IdP metadata (SAML), KMS key ARN & IAM policy, SIEM endpoint for log forwarding, retention policy (7 days), list of admin IP ranges, and whether they require mutual TLS for webhooks. I will join kickoff.

Alex (AE): Action items: Rina to share POC runbook + demo repo with streaming->toolcall example by EOD Thu; Jorge to prepare security checklist and questionnaire template by Thu; Alex to collect IdP/KMS details from Lifecare by Wed. I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue morning.

Rina - Solutions Eng: I'll attach a minimal Private config snippet in the runbook (example only):

```yaml
private:
  vpc_id: vpc-0a1b2c3d
  sso:
    provider: saml
    metadata_url: https://idp.lifecare.example/metadata
  kms:
    type: customer_managed
    key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
  persistence:
    user_content: disabled
    audit_logs: forward_to_siem
    retention_days: 7
```

Rina - Solutions Eng: I'll also include an STS flow for short-lived tokens for connectors and recommend HMAC-signed webhooks with replay nonce or mTLS. Will send the preread shortly.

Alex (AE): Great, thanks everyone. I'll push lifecare to share the security questionnaire and IdP/KMS stuff asap. :thumbsup:
